why: phase-483 W1 — the `Result`-returning teardown that was `nros::shutdown()`. Upstream's `rclcpp::shutdown()` returns `bool` with the same empty argument list, so the two could not coexist under one name; ours takes the `_in` suffix (RFC-0089's `_in` rule: ours-only contract, `Result` channel). `rclcpp::shutdown()` is upstream's and reports `shutdown_in().ok()`.
